title: Hold a commercial agent licence
what: Hold a commercial agent licence before doing commercial agent activity (such as debt collection and repossession field work).

sources.title: Fair Trading Act 1987 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not do any of the following for the purposes of carrying out a commercial agent activity unless the person holds a commercial agent licence
